body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one item or unattended object within 4 units. Until your next turn, it gains a minor supernatural property appropriate to the card and counts as magical.

surges.html: One ally inside, warded by, or otherwise protected by this Rite gains +1 Defense until the start of its next turn.
If the Rite targets a Possessed creature, you may remove Possessed after an Echo resolves.

rider.title: IMBUEMENT RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: The imbued object or creature is used for a Basic Action. Echo: That Action gains 1 free Surge.
